summary: This manuscript presents MATVER-BORDERRANK-CERT-1.0, a fully machine-checked, zero-float algebraic certification suite formalizing bilinear tensor rank, Z[epsilon] border-rank witnesses, asymptotic tau-theorem exponent bounds, and deterministic linear-probe derandomization barriers in Lean 4.36.0 and exact Z/Q Python certificates. Building upon Xiangle Chen's decision-tree-to-border-rank reduction, the work rigorously verifies Strassen's 7-product identity, integer power exponent ceilings, Schönhage direct-sum border-rank savings, and explicit Vandermonde nullspace kernel witnesses proving that low-rank linear probing is insufficient for deterministic matrix product verification.
